name: decktet
description: Printable Decktet cards cut into game assets, plus a mobile-first PWA playing Adaman, Jacynth and Gongor Whist.

scripts.test: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do echo "▶ $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.assets: python3 scripts/extract_cards.py && python3 scripts/analyze_cards.py && python3 scripts/build_manifest.py && python3 scripts/build_icons.py
